adjudicated_statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. Let H=H_{4,6}(P^1) be the Deligne-Mumford stack of finite degree-four covers of a fixed P^1 by smooth connected genus-six curves, and let H^bal be the open locus where the Casnati-Ekedahl relations bundle in the packet orientation F=ker(Sym^2 E -> gamma_*(omega_{C/P^1}^{otimes 2})) is isomorphic to O_{P^1}(4)+O_{P^1}(5) (rank two, degree +9). Write Hbar^bal=[H^bal/PGL_2]. Call gamma simply branched when every geometric fibre has partition type 2+1+1+1, equivalently when every local monodromy permutation in S_4 is a transposition, equivalently when gamma has eighteen distinct simple branch values. (1) The packet's self-contained nonemptiness witness for H^bal (FND-0154: gamma=q o psi through a smooth genus-one curve) is never simply branched. This is FND-0158: a nontrivial factorization C->Y->P^1 of degrees (2,2) has a fibre of type (2,2) or 4 over each branch value of q, since every degree-two map Y->P^1 is ramified (Riemann-Hurwitz: deg R_q=2g_Y+2>=2); equivalently, a simply-branched connected degree-four cover has monodromy group S_4, which is primitive, while a nontrivial factorization is imprimitive. Under the extra reducedness and disjointness hypotheses of FND-0158(b), the FND-0154 family has fourteen branch values (ten of type 2+1+1 and four of type (2,2)), and the set of simply-branched type-(ii) points is empty. Consequently FND-0154 may not be cited as a simply-branched balanced cover. (2) Existence of a simply-branched point of H^bal, equivalently of Hbar^bal, is not supplied by FND-0154, nor by the type-(i) density statement of FND-0162 (type (i) means not FND-0153 type (ii), which excludes only the bielliptic-through-a-plane-cubic case and still permits primitive non-simple ramification). Any construction that needs a simply-branched balanced cover — in particular any argument that places a Hurwitz chart etale over M_{0,18} or Conf_18 inside the balanced locus — must discharge existence by one of the following routes. Route A (packet-internal dimension comparison): H is smooth of pure dimension 18 at every point, independently of ramification profile (FND-0159). The classical Hurwitz space of a fixed ramification profile with r distinct branch values is etale over the configuration space of those r points and has dimension r, which equals 18 if and only if the cover is simply branched (FND-0159; Kanev, arXiv:math/0509154, Introduction: the discriminant map of the simply-branched Hurwitz space is etale onto Y^{(n)}-Delta, with Delta the codimension-one locus of non-simple divisors). Hence the non-simply-branched locus in H has dimension at most 17. Combined with nonemptiness of H^bal (FND-0154) and the fact that H^bal is open of pure dimension 18 (FND-0162, FND-0163), every nonempty connected component of H^bal, and of the quotient Hbar^bal of pure dimension 15, meets the simply-branched locus. Equivalently, after the PGL_2 quotient, the same comparison is the dual-confirmed bound dim(non-simply-branched)<=14 in Hbar^bal of pure dimension 15 recorded as CLM-0112-4. Route B (Bujokas-Patel genericity): for a general point of the classical irreducible simply-branched Hurwitz space H_{d,g}, the Casnati-Ekedahl bundle of quadrics F is balanced whenever g>=(d-3)(d-1) (Bujokas-Patel, arXiv:1504.03756v1, IMRN 2021, Main Theorem; algebraically closed field of characteristic zero). Here F is defined by 0->F->Sym^2 E->alpha_*(omega_alpha^{otimes 2})->0, with rk F=d(d-3)/2 and deg F=(d-3)(g+d-1), and balanced means h^1(End F)=0. At (d,g)=(4,6) one has g=6>=3, rk F=2, deg F=9, hence F isomorphic to O(4)+O(5), matching the packet orientation. This route does not use FND-0154. FND-0163 records it only inside a NOT ASSERTED clause, so a proof that invokes it must cite the theorem independently. (3) This existence hinge is inherited by every argument that realises an etale chart of Hbar^bal over M_{0,18} or Conf_18. It does not by itself control Gr^W_16 H_c^{16} of the evaluation-failure model Z, nor the campaign target RED-0001.
contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the finding does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with corroborated packet findings FND-0154, FND-0158, FND-0159, FND-0162, and FND-0163, and is not a restatement of any one of them. Local originating artifacts (not source_records): ATT-0118 section 3 asserts nonemptiness of the simply-branched balanced open by citing CLM-0112-2, CLM-0112-4, and CLM-0112-7, then places a Hurwitz chart etale over M_{0,18} inside that open. REV-0165 confirms those claims, flags CLM-0112-4 as the single external geometric input the disproof cannot do without, and records the present candidate (key simply-branched-balanced-witness-is-a-load-bearing-hinge) as a derived composition constraint. Direct packet check: FND-0154 supplies a balanced witness gamma=q o psi through a smooth genus-one curve; FND-0158(a) proves no nontrivially factoring degree-four cover is simply branched (S_4 generated by transpositions is primitive; equivalently every degree-two q:Y->P^1 is ramified by Riemann-Hurwitz, so fibres of gamma over Ram(q) have type (2,2) or 4); FND-0158(b) specialises this to the FND-0154 family (fourteen branch values, ten of type 2+1+1 and four of type (2,2)). Thus the packet witness lies entirely outside the simply-branched locus and cannot be cited as a simply-branched cover. FND-0162's type-(i) density (composed locus of dimension at most 14 in H^bal of dimension 18) is a different dichotomy: type (i) means not FND-0153 type (ii), so it still permits primitive non-simple ramification. FND-0159 already records that the classical Hurwitz space of a fixed ramification profile is etale over Conf_r and has dimension r, equal to 2d+2g-2=18 if and only if the cover is simply branched; Kanev (arXiv:math/0509154, Introduction) independently states that associating the discriminant yields an etale map from the simply-branched Hurwitz space onto Y^{(n)}-Delta, with Delta the codimension-one locus of non-simple divisors. Combined with smoothness of H of pure dimension 18 at every point (FND-0159) and openness of H^bal of pure dimension 18 (FND-0162/FND-0163), this packet-internal comparison already produces simply-branched balanced points once H^bal is nonempty, so the original candidate's 'follows only from purity of dimension 15 of Hbar^bal together with CLM-0112-4' overclaims uniqueness of that citation. Independently, Bujokas-Patel (arXiv:1504.03756v1 = IMRN 2021, Main Theorem), working over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, prove that a general point of the irreducible Hurwitz space H_{d,g} has balanced Casnati-Ekedahl bundle of quadrics F whenever g>=(d-3)(d-1); the paper identifies H_{d,g} as the irreducible Hurwitz space of degree-d genus-g branched covers of P^1 (a general such cover is simply branched), defines F by 0->F->Sym^2 E->alpha_*(omega_alpha^{otimes 2})->0 with rk F=d(d-3)/2 and deg F=(d-3)(g+d-1), and takes balanced to mean h^1(End F)=0. At (d,g)=(4,6) one has g=6>=3, rk F=2, deg F=9, hence F isomorphic to O(4)+O(5), matching the packet orientation. FND-0163 records this genericity only inside a NOT ASSERTED clause, so a proof that uses it must cite the theorem independently rather than the packet parenthetical. Distinct from FND-0158 (composed covers are never simply branched, without the existence/citation hinge) and from FND-0162 (type-(i) density). Do not merge. The original candidate text is narrowed: drop the exclusive 'only from CLM-0112-4' clause, record the FND-0159/Kanev dimension comparison and Bujokas-Patel as admissible existence routes, and keep the prohibition on treating FND-0154 as a simply-branched witness. Promote from candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source.
